segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly say the cleanser does not leave their skin tight, dry, or stripped and can even feel hydrating, but a real minority — including one with dry, sensitive, sun-damaged skin — report it dried their face out badly, caused stinging or burning, or left a stripped feeling, especially with twice-daily use.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one who calls it extremely oily, say the cleanser keeps their face shine-free all day without over-drying, and one adds it faded acne scars and discoloration on her cheeks.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one in her 50s and one in her 30s, say the cleanser lathers well, cleanses thoroughly, and does not dry out their skin, though one mentions a small breakout that she attributes to switching cleansers.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or allergy-prone skin, report no irritation, redness, or breakouts, but the exceptions are severe: one reviewer with dry, sensitive, sun-damaged skin found it drying and burning, and another had a widespread hives and redness reaction after a reported ingredient change.
segments.normal: The two reviewers who describe their skin as normal (normal-to-oily and normal-to-dry) both say the cleanser does not dry their skin out.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s, and 60s generally describe softer, more even, younger-looking skin with regular use, though a 50-year-old with an established multi-step routine found the cleanser too thick and heavy for her needs, and stinging in her eyes.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who focus on the anti-aging claim report firmer, softer, more even-toned skin, less visible puffiness and crow's feet, and lines that look less deep with continued use, though results are gradual and lines are rarely described as fully gone; one reviewer explicitly doubts a rinsed-off cleanser has enough contact time for its anti-aging ingredients to work.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, say the cleanser does not dry out their skin and often describe it as hydrating, but a consistent minority — especially those with already dry or sensitive skin, or using it twice daily — report significant dryness, stinging, flaking, or a stripped feeling.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness say the cleanser leaves their skin calm with no redness or blotchiness, but there are two serious exceptions: one reviewer developed hives and redness across her face, neck, and chest, and another got immediate red patches and a burning sensation.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who discusses discoloration says her acne scars and dark spots have almost completely disappeared with continued use, and two others report a more even skin tone overall.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some who call themselves breakout-prone, say the cleanser does not cause new blemishes and one reports it clearing acne scars, though one reviewer feels it broke her out more and another had a minor breakout she attributes to switching products.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say the cleanser leaves their face shine-free and reduces oiliness without over-drying it.

Bought this, eye cream, face cream from Plantscription line in June. All have been irritating around my eyes & not nearly moisturizing enough. Found cleanser drying, causes skin around eyes to burn, & worst of all, causes my lips to burn like fire!!!

I have very dry, sensitive skin. Origns cleanser is thick so a little goes a long way and make sure to cleanse your face twice. Origns Cleanser does not irritate my skin or leave it red afterwards. My face doesn't feel tight or dry after using it. My face looks and feels clean. Lastly it has a very low mild scent for anybody who doesn't like scents in there cleanser.

extraits.titre: Hands down the best cleanser EVER!
extraits.texte: I am a 41yo military spouse with Rosacea. I have no lines or wrinkles. I want to keep it that way. We move every 2-4 years, wherever our new home is I have had to change my skincare routine to accommodate the new climate/weather. I do not have to switch cleansers. I have been using this cleanser for a few years. And I love it! Here's why: On a daily basis every morning I use a face moisturizer, a SPF 70 Sunblock, a face primer, and face powder. This cleanser is the first cleanser I have used that takes EVERYTHING off the 1st time and DOES NOT dry out my skin or make it red/blotchy or breakout. It makes my skin feel clean, soft, and hydrated. Other cleansers have made my face red, and feel tight and dry after use. I have tried too many cleanser to list, from dr prescribed to drugstore brand to high end brands. I will definitely be purchasing Planscriptions Anti-Aging Cleanser again & again & again!

I just recently came back to Origins after a long hiatus, and this cleanser is absolutely marvelous for my 50+ year-old combination skin. It lathers beautifully and cleanses well without drying-out my skin. My face is glowing for the first time in years! I use the Plantscription cleanser, lotion, serum, lifting cream, eye cream and overnight mask. What a lovely product line! I am truly loving my skin for the first time in a long while...

extraits.titre: Works great even on young skin
extraits.texte: I'm only 22 years old, so I don't necessarily need an anti-aging cleanser but I LOVE this product. I have very oily skin, and this is the first cleanser I've found that keeps my face shine-free all day. I used to have lots of acne scars/discoloration on my cheeks, and the spots have almost completely disappeared. This stuff is amazing.

I liked this product well enough. I am 50 years old with a well established skincare routine. The cleanser was a little on the thicker side than what I normally use and it was a little harder to rinse off. It left a light moisture on the skin after it was rinsed. This cleanser is ideal for people who wash and go but want the anti-aging properties. For me, it was too heavy because I add serums after washing and then moisturizer. It was too much in my case. The only drawback for me was that it did sting my eyes a bit. This product was sent t me complimentary for testing purposes.
